**Generated by:** openai/gpt-5-mini | **Approach:** Agent | **Report Date:** 2026-06-06

---

## Coverage Definition

> **Missing coverage** = An entire scenario or behaviour that is completely absent from the generated tests but is present in the ground truth.
>
> **Partial negative coverage is acceptable** — if the ground truth tests multiple individual-field empty/invalid cases and the generated tests cover at least one representative field of the same type, that counts as covered. Similarly, if the ground truth tests one dropdown and the generated tests test a different dropdown of the same type, that is still acceptable coverage.
>
> **Extra** = scenarios present in the generated tests but not in the ground truth.

## Overall Findings

### Missing Coverage — Consolidated List

| # | Module | Missing Scenario | Impact |
|---|--------|-----------------|--------|
| 1 | Dashboard | Dashboard - deep link bypassing dashboard | High (Security) |
| 2 | Client | Concurrent activation | High (Data Integrity) |
| 3 | Login | SQL injection payload in Username field | High (Security) |
| 4 | Client | HTML injection in First Name | High (Security) |
| 5 | System Admin | Disable core scheduled job | High (System Stability) |
| 6 | Global Search | SQL injection in search bar | High (Security) |

### Generated Tests Strengths
The GPT-5-Mini Agent successfully maps the highly complex domain architecture of Mifos and generated a massive test suite of **807 tests**. As shown by the **1.33 Ratio**, it is highly exhaustive. It correctly identified the core entity flows (Offices -> Centers -> Groups -> Clients -> Accounts) and went far beyond the ground truth in terms of **UI edge cases, unicode interactions, network drops, and extreme text boundaries**.

However, the agent's generative tendency leans towards UI/Input manipulation rather than backend business rules. While it explores 338 *extra* UI scenarios, it misses **65 critical "hacker-level" scenarios**. It consistently misses **ultra-precise float boundaries (e.g., exactly 0.01 over limits)**, **complex dependency blocking** (e.g., trying to delete a parent entity that has active children), **network race conditions**, and **advanced SQLi/XSS payloads**. This indicates that while the agent provides excellent UI boundary coverage, security and complex financial dependency testing still require targeted human heuristics or specialized security profiles.
